items.title: Department of Homeland Security: executive department, mission and civil-liberties and investigation boundaries
items.source_scope: Establishes DHS and defines its mission; expressly preserves nonsecurity functions, economic security, civil rights, civil liberties, and investigative/prosecution jurisdiction boundaries.

items.title: Secretary of Homeland Security: appointments, direction and limited delegation
items.source_scope: Creates and specifies Secretary's departmental direction and delegation, with express statutory exceptions and responsibility limits.

items.title: Department of Education: establishment and Secretary appointment
items.source_scope: Establishes Department of Education and presidential appointment of Senate-confirmed Secretary.

items.title: Education Secretary: authority for transferred functions
items.source_scope: Transfers preexisting function authorities as available by law; no new general federal control over schools.

items.title: Department of Education relationship with States and historical transition provision
items.source_scope: Protects State/local educational control; limits construction of Department power; includes historically time-limited subsection (c).

items.title: General Education Provisions Act: federal-control restriction
items.source_scope: General Education Provisions Act restriction on inferring curriculum/program/school personnel direction from covered federal educational programs.
